// UnpackInput attempts to decode the provided call data using contract method definitions.
func (token *Token) UnpackInput(callData []byte) (any, error) {
	if len(callData) < 4 {
		return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["allowance"].ID[:4]) {
		return tokenUnpackInput[Token_Allowance_Input]("allowance", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["approveAndCall"].ID[:4]) {
		return tokenUnpackInput[Token_ApproveAndCall_Input]("approveAndCall", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["balanceOf"].ID[:4]) {
		return tokenUnpackInput[Token_BalanceOf_Input]("balanceOf", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["decimals"].ID[:4]) {
		return token.Decimals, nil
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["name"].ID[:4]) {
		return token.Name, nil
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["spentAllowance"].ID[:4]) {
		return tokenUnpackInput[Token_SpentAllowance_Input]("spentAllowance", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["symbol"].ID[:4]) {
		return token.Symbol, nil
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["transfer"].ID[:4]) {
		return tokenUnpackInput[Token_Transfer_Input]("transfer", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _TokenABI.Methods["transferFrom"].ID[:4]) {
		return tokenUnpackInput[Token_TransferFrom_Input]("transferFrom", callData)
	}
	return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
}

// Token_Transfer_Event is the Go binding around the Transfer contract event.
// Topic0: 0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef
// Solidity: event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)
type Token_Transfer_Event struct {
	From  common.Address
	To    common.Address
	Value *big.Int
	Raw   *types.Log // Blockchain specific contextual infos
}

const Token_Transfer_EventName = "Transfer"

func (e Token_Transfer_Event) Name() string { return Token_Transfer_EventName }
func (e Token_Transfer_Event) Topic0() common.Hash {
	return common.HexToHash("0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef")
}
func (e Token_Transfer_Event) Unpack(log *types.Log) (*Token_Transfer_Event, error) {
	return tokenUnpackEvent[Token_Transfer_Event](e.Name(), log)
}
func (out *Token_Transfer_Event) unpack(values []any) {
	out.Value = tokenConvertType[*big.Int](values[0])
}
func (out *Token_Transfer_Event) setRaw(log *types.Log) { out.Raw = log }

// UnpackEvent unpacks event log based on topic0.
func (token *Token) UnpackEvent(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
	if len(log.Topics) == 0 {
		return nil, errNoEventSignature
	}
	for _, item := range tokenEventUnpackers {
		if item.id == log.Topics[0] {
			return item.unpack(log)
		}
	}
	return nil, errEventSignatureMismatch
}

type tokenEventUnpacker struct {
	id     common.Hash
	unpack func(*types.Log) (any, error)
}

type tokenErrorUnpacker struct {
	id     [4]byte
	unpack func([]byte) (any, error)
}

var tokenEventUnpackers = []tokenEventUnpacker{
	{id: common.HexToHash("0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef"), unpack: func(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
		return (Token_Transfer_Event{}).Unpack(log)
	}},
}

func tokenMust[T any](val T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return val
}

func tokenConvertType[T any](value any) T {
	return *abi.ConvertType(value, new(T)).(*T)
}

func tokenCallRaw(ctx context.Context, client bind.ContractCaller, addr common.Address, opts *bind.CallOpts, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	var callOpts bind.CallOpts
	if opts != nil {
		callOpts = *opts
	}
	callOpts.Context = ctx
	return bind.NewBoundContract(addr, *_TokenABI, client, nil, nil).CallRaw(&callOpts, input)
}

func tokenUnpackInput[T any](name string, callData []byte) (*T, error) {
	method, ok := _TokenABI.Methods[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("method '" + name + "' not found")
	}
	if len(callData) < 4 || !bytes.Equal(callData[:4], method.ID[:4]) {
		return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
	}
	arguments, err := method.Inputs.Unpack(callData[4:])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	input := new(T)
	any(input).(interface{ unpack([]any) }).unpack(arguments)
	return input, nil
}

func tokenUnpackEvent[T any](name string, log *types.Log) (*T, error) {
	event, ok := _TokenABI.Events[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("event '" + name + "' not found")
	}
	if len(log.Topics) == 0 {
		return nil, errNoEventSignature
	}
	if log.Topics[0] != event.ID {
		return nil, errEventSignatureMismatch
	}
	var values []any
	if len(log.Data) > 0 {
		var err error
		values, err = event.Inputs.Unpack(log.Data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	out := new(T)
	eventData := any(out).(interface {
		unpack([]any)
		setRaw(*types.Log)
	})
	eventData.unpack(values)
	var indexed abi.Arguments
	for _, arg := range event.Inputs {
		if arg.Indexed {
			indexed = append(indexed, arg)
		}
	}
	if err := abi.ParseTopics(out, indexed, log.Topics[1:]); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	eventData.setRaw(log)
	return out, nil
}
